camel_example: aliyun ga CreateCustomRoutingEndpoints --region cn-hangzhou --EndpointConfigurations.1.Endpoint 'vsw-test01' --EndpointGroupId 'epg-bp1bpn0kn908w4nb0000' --EndpointConfigurations.1.TrafficToEndpointPolicy DenyAll --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --EndpointConfigurations.1.Type PrivateSubNet
description_en: Invokes the CreateCustomRoutingEndpoints operation to create endpoints for a custom route type listener
description_zh: 调用CreateCustomRoutingEndpoints接口创建自定义路由类型监听的终端节点
kebab_example: aliyun ga create-custom-routing-endpoints --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1bpn0kn908w4nb0000 --endpoint-configurations '[{"Type":"PrivateSubNet","Endpoint":"vsw-test01","PolicyConfigurations":[{}],"TrafficToEndpointPolicy":"DenyAll"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomRoutingEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of a request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group in which you want to create an endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 待创建终端节点的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the endpoint vSwitch
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en:
The IP address of the traffic destination that can receive traffic.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify up to 20 traffic destination IP addresses for each endpoint
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标IP地址。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标IP地址
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The start port of the traffic destination that can receive traffic. The port value must fall within the backend service port range of the endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify up to 20 port ranges for each endpoint, and up to 20 start ports for each traffic destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的起始端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入20个起始端口
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The end port of the traffic destination that can receive traffic. The port value must fall within the backend service port range of the endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify up to 20 port ranges for each endpoint, and up to 20 end ports for each traffic destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的结束端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入20个结束端口
fields.name: to_port

fields.help_en:
The port range of the traffic destination that can receive traffic. The port range must fall within the backend service port range of the endpoint group.

If this parameter is left empty, all ports of the traffic destination are supported.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify up to 20 port ranges for each endpoint, and up to 20 port ranges for each traffic destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标端口范围。该端口范围必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入20个端口范围
fields.name: port_ranges

fields.help_en:
The traffic destination configurations.

You can specify up to 20 traffic destinations for each endpoint
fields.help_zh:
流量通行目标配置。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标
fields.name: policy_configurations

fields.help_en:
The traffic policy for the backend service. Valid values:
DenyAll (default): denies all traffic to the specified backend service.
AllowAll: allows all traffic to the specified backend service.
AllowCustom: allows traffic only to specified destinations.
You must specify the IP address and port range of the destination. If the port range is left empty, all ports of the destination are supported
fields.help_zh:
后端服务流量通行策略，取值：
DenyAll（默认值）：拒绝所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。
AllowAll：允许所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。
AllowCustom：指定可以接收访问流量的通行目标。
您需要指定该通信目标的IP地址和端口范围，端口范围输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口
fields.name: traffic_to_endpoint_policy

fields.help_en:
The backend service type of the endpoint. Valid values:

 PrivateSubNet (default): private CIDR block
fields.help_zh:
终端节点后端服务类型。取值：

 PrivateSubNet（默认值）：私网CIDR
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint configurations.

You can specify up to 20 endpoint configurations
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点信息。

您最多可输入20个终端节点信息
parameters.name: endpoint_configurations
